overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（2 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、机器学习为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（5 篇）。

papers.title: Voters uncovered: home insurance and the electoral effects of climate costs
papers.venue: Journal of Political Institutions and Political Economy
papers.abstract: How do voters react to the financial costs of climate change? I study this question in the context of the growing home insurance crisis in the United States. Drawing on county- and ZIP code-level panel data, I examine whether home insurance distress has affected turnout and voter choices in gubernatorial and insurance commissioner elections in the period 2014–2024. I find that home insurance distress is associated with higher turnout and lower roll-off in downballot insurance commissioner races. By contrast, impacts on electoral returns across offices vary and do not provide consistent evidence for partisan or anti-incumbent effects. I interpret these results as indicating that home insurance distress is mobilizing voters, but in the absence of clear partisan issue ownership and messaging from incumbents, not yet systematically affecting their choices. Nevertheless, voter reactions to insurance distress may create incentives for incumbents to protect their constituents from climate costs, posing political risk – but also potentially providing leverage – to private insurers.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】选民如何应对气候变化的财务成本？我在美国日益严重的房屋保险危机的背景下研究了这一问题。利用县级和邮政编码级别的面板数据，我考察了2014年至2024年间房屋保险困境是否影响了选民的投票率和在州长选举及保险监管委员会选举中的投票选择。研究发现，房屋保险困境与较高的投票率以及保险监管委员会选举中较低的弃选率相关。相比之下，这种影响在不同职位上的表现各不相同，且并未显示出明显的党派倾向或反对现任者的趋势。我将这些结果解读为：房屋保险困境正在动员选民，但由于现任者尚未就相关问题形成明确的党派立场和宣传策略，因此尚未系统性地影响选民的投票选择。尽管如此，选民对保险困境的反应可能会促使现任者采取措施保护选民免受气候变化带来的财务影响，这既可能给私营保险公司带来政治风险，也可能为他们提供谈判筹码。。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: Evaluation of marginal and average sectorial GHGs emissions abatement costs using an open-source energy system optimization model: the Italian case study
papers.venue: Mitigation and Adaptation Strategies for Global Change
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  To achieve a carbon-neutral Europe by 2050, emission reduction efforts must be supported by quantitative tools that capture the interactions among sectors and technologies. This paper proposes a methodology to evaluate system-wide marginal abatement costs and sectorial and sub-sectorial average abatement costs with a multi-sectoral energy system optimization model. The approach compares the total system cost and emissions of a sequence of whole-system optimizations under progressively stricter emission constraints. The constraints are applied along the entire decarbonization trajectory rather than to a single target year. The resulting marginal costs are then allocated to the sectors and technologies that deliver each emission reduction step. Since every point of the curve corresponds to a consistent system configuration, technology interactions and sector coupling are preserved, and each cost level can be traced back to the technology transitions and input assumptions that drive it. The methodology is demonstrated on the Italian energy system with the open-source TEMOA-Italy model, considering emission reduction targets of up to -90% in 2050. The results show that marginal abatement costs rise steeply as the targets become more ambitious, and that abatement costs vary widely across sectors. The power sector is the cheapest to decarbonize, thanks to mature renewable technologies. Transport shows intermediate costs, with marked differences across its sub-sectors. The industrial and residential sectors show the highest costs and contribute mainly at the most ambitious targets. The open-source framework allows the approach to be reproduced and transferred to other energy systems.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】摘要  
为实现2050年欧洲的碳中和目标，减排工作需要借助能够捕捉各部门和技术之间相互作用的定量工具来加以支持。本文提出了一种评估方法，该方法利用多部门能源系统优化模型来计算系统层面的边际减排成本以及各部门和子部门的平均减排成本。该方法通过对比在逐步严格的排放约束下进行的一系列系统优化方案的总系统成本和排放量来进行分析，这些约束贯穿整个脱碳进程，而不仅仅针对某一特定目标年份。计算出的边际成本随后被分配给实现每一步减排目标的各部门和技术。由于曲线上的每个点都对应着一种稳定的系统配置，因此技术间的相互作用和部门间的耦合关系得以保持，且每个成本水平都可以追溯到驱动其变化的技术转型和输入假设。该方法以开源的TEMOA-Italy模型为案例，在意大利能源系统上进行了验证，该模型设定了到2050年减排90%的目标。研究结果表明，随着减排目标的提高，边际减排成本急剧上升，且不同部门的减排成本存在显著差异：电力部门由于拥有成熟的可再生能源技术，其脱碳成本最低；交通运输部门的成本处于中等水平，但其内部各子部门的成本差异较大；工业和住宅部门的成本最高，且在最雄心勃勃的减排目标下贡献最大。这一开源框...。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Path-Independent Deleveraging Rules
papers.abstract: We characterise path-independent auto-deleveraging (ADL) rules as an extended log-exponential family. Immunity to account splitting, merging and reopening further restrict the class. Homogeneity (essentially) restricts the class to a one-parameter family ordered by both fairness and platform risk. Its split-proof members continuously interpolate between proportional division and water-filling. Among these rules, decreasing the parameter reduces risk at the cost of increasing inequality in how accounts are treated. This suggests selecting the parameter through an ex-ante calibration to a risk bound on historical data to choose a maximally fair rule subject to that bound. A counterfactual replay of Hyperliquid's ADL episode on 10 October 2025 finds that a range of intermediate parameters significantly improves on the observed allocation in both burden dispersion and subsequent risk statistics.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们将路径无关的自动去杠杆化（ADL）规则描述为一个扩展的对数-指数族。这些规则对账户分割、合并和重新开放具有免疫力，这进一步限制了该规则类的范围。规则的同质性基本上将其限制为一个由公平性和平台风险共同决定的单参数族。该族中的规则能够在按比例分配和“水填充”（即平均分配）两种方式之间进行连续过渡。在这些规则中，减小参数值可以在降低风险的同时增加账户处理方式的不平等程度。因此，建议通过预先根据历史数据的风险上限进行校准来选择参数值，从而在满足风险上限的前提下实现最公平的分配规则。通过对2025年10月10日Hyperliquid平台ADL事件的反事实模拟发现，使用一系列中间参数值可以在负担分配和后续风险统计指标方面显著改善实际观察到的分配结果。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Optimal Control in Pairs Trading with Negative-Power Utility
papers.abstract: We solve a finite-horizon consumption and investment problem in a pairs trading model with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spread and utility $U(x)=-x^{-γ}$, $γ>0$. Linearizing the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation gives explicit formulas for the value function and the optimal feedback control. A budget inequality and concavity verify optimality over all admissible strategies with nonnegative wealth on every finite horizon, without Novikov's condition. Under the optimal feedback, wealth and consumption admit deterministic upper bounds when the interest rate $r$ is at most the mean-reversion rate $κ$. If $r>κ$, each exceeds any prescribed level with positive probability at every time after the start. If $r>\sqrt{2+γ} κ$, there is an explicit critical horizon at and beyond which expected terminal wealth is infinite, while optimal expected utility is finite. When the critical time falls before maturity, expected wealth at that time is finite exactly when the initial spread is zero. We also show that the suprema of the negative powers of optimal wealth and consumption are integrable on every finite horizon exactly for orders $0<m\le 1+γ$.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个有限视界下的消费与投资问题，该问题发生在具有Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散机制的对冲交易模型中，效用函数为$U(x)=-x^{-γ}$（其中$γ>0$）。通过对Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程进行线性化处理，我们可以得到价值函数和最优反馈控制的显式表达式。预算不等式以及效用函数的凹性特性确保了在所有允许的策略下，只要初始财富非负，无论在哪个有限视界内都能实现最优解，且无需满足Novikov条件。在最优反馈控制下，当利率$r$不超过均值回归率$\κ$时，财富和消费水平都存在确定的 upper bound（上限）。如果$r>κ$，则从开始后的任何时刻起，这两者都有正概率超过任意预设的水平。当$r>\sqrt{2+γ}κ$时，存在一个临界视界：在该临界视界及以后，预期终值财富为无穷大，而最优预期效用则为有限值。如果临界时刻早于到期时间，那么当初始扩散率为零时，该时刻的预期财富也为有限值。此外，我们还证明了在每个有限视界内，最优财富和消费的负幂次的最大值对于$0<m\le 1+γ$的所有阶数都是可积的。。

papers.title: DeepChem-DEL: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible DEL Modeling and Benchmarking
papers.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) allow screening of extremely large chemical spaces by tagging compounds with DNA barcodes. Machine learning (ML) techniques have enabled the extraction of meaningful chemical patterns from noisy, target-specific DEL binding data. However, existing tools for DEL machine learning (DEL-ML) remain fragmented, which limits systematic construction and reproducibility of modeling pipelines. Moreover, this fragmentation hinders integration of new models, such as chemical foundation models, into DEL workflows alongside classical approaches. To address these challenges in DEL modeling, we introduce DeepChem-DEL, an open-source suite of reproducible ML workflows for DEL modeling built on the DeepChem ecosystem. DeepChem-DEL integrates (i) a configurable denoising pipeline with (ii) modular DeepChem workflows for enrichment prediction, hit identification, and benchmarking across diverse model classes, including chemical foundation models enabled through extensions to the open-source ChemBERTa-3 framework. We evaluate DeepChem-DEL on the KinDEL and BELKA data sets, reproducing key baselines and enabling direct comparison across model classes. Our experiments demonstrate that leveraging chemical foundation models yields performance competitive with, and in several cases exceeding, previously explored approaches such as graph convolutional networks and random forest models. Together, these results demonstrate that DeepChem-DEL is a scalable and extensible platform for DEL-ML, while highlighting the potential of chemical foundation models for improved DEL modeling and prioritization.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
DNA编码库（DELs）通过为化合物添加DNA条形码，实现了对庞大化学空间的高效筛选。机器学习（ML）技术能够帮助从嘈杂的、针对特定目标的DEL结合数据中提取有意义的化学模式。然而，现有的DEL机器学习工具仍然存在碎片化问题，这限制了建模流程的系统性构建和可重复性。此外，这种碎片化还阻碍了新型模型（如化学基础模型）与经典方法在DEL工作流程中的整合。为了解决DEL建模中的这些问题，我们推出了DeepChem-DEL——这是一个基于DeepChem生态系统的开源ML工作流程套件，用于DEL建模。DeepChem-DEL整合了：（1）一个可配置的去噪流程；（2）模块化的DeepChem工作流程，用于富集预测、命中化合物识别以及跨不同模型类别的基准测试（包括通过扩展开源ChemBERTa-3框架实现的化学基础模型）。我们在KinDEL和BELKA数据集上对DeepChem-DEL进行了评估，结果验证了其性能，并实现了模型类别间的直接比较。实验表明，利用化学基础模型所获得的性能与以往研究的方法（如图卷积网络和随机森林模型）相当，在某些情况下甚至更优。这些结果共同证明了DeepC...。研究方法：机器学习、随机森林、实验方法。

papers.title: Integrating proper orthogonal decomposition and transformers for flow predictions inside cerebral aneurysm in various body physiologies: A computational-based approach
papers.venue: International Journal of Modern Physics C
papers.abstract: Aneurysm rupture remains a critical challenge in medical diagnostics, and understanding the underlying hemodynamic factors is essential for assessing rupture risk. This study combines computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations and machine learning models to analyze the hemodynamics of aneurysms in real patient-specific models. The focus was on key hemodynamic parameters such as wall shear stress (WSS), oscillatory shear index (OSI) and pressure, which play a crucial role in predicting aneurysm rupture. High-fidelity CFD simulations were conducted for aneurysm models under both rest and exercise conditions, revealing detailed flow patterns and localized variations in shear stress. A machine learning approach, combining proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) and Transformer models, was employed to predict these hemodynamic parameters efficiently, offering a reduced-order model for real-time applications. The results showed that while the machine learning predictions accurately captured the overall trends in OSI, WSS and pressure, some local discrepancies were observed, particularly in regions of high shear stress. These findings highlight the potential of integrating CFD with machine learning for improved aneurysm risk assessment and management, though further refinement is necessary to enhance prediction accuracy, particularly in complex regions of interest.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】动脉瘤破裂仍然是医学诊断中的一个关键挑战，理解其背后的血流动力学因素对于评估破裂风险至关重要。本研究结合了计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟和机器学习模型，分析了真实患者特定模型中的动脉瘤血流动力学特征。研究重点关注了壁面剪切应力（WSS）、振荡剪切指数（OSI）和压力等关键血流动力学参数，这些参数在预测动脉瘤破裂中起着重要作用。研究人员对动脉瘤模型在静息状态和运动状态下的血流动力学进行了高保真CFD模拟，揭示了详细的流动模式以及剪切应力的局部变化。研究采用了一种结合适当正交分解（POD）和Transformer模型的机器学习方法，高效地预测了这些血流动力学参数，从而为实时应用提供了简化后的模型。结果表明，虽然机器学习预测结果准确反映了OSI、WSS和压力的整体趋势，但在高剪切应力区域仍存在一些局部差异。这些发现表明，将CFD与机器学习相结合有助于提升动脉瘤风险评估和管理的效率，但还需进一步优化以提高预测精度，尤其是在复杂区域。。研究方法：数值模拟、机器学习、Transformer 模型。

papers.title: Investor sentiment and equity returns in China: a quantile-on-quantile analysis
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    This study investigates the non-linear and asymmetric relationship between investor sentiment and equity returns in China, examining how sentiment influences market-wide and sectoral returns under different market conditions. It seeks to establish whether sentiment–return relationships vary across bullish, bearish and neutral regimes and across industries with differing characteristics. By focusing on China’s distinctive institutional environment, the study contributes to understanding investor sentiment as a state-dependent behavioural predictor of equity returns rather than necessarily a priced systematic risk factor.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    Using monthly data from January 2014 to December 2023, the study examines the CSI 300 Index and ten sectoral indices. Investor sentiment indices are constructed following Baker and Wurgler (2006), using principal component analysis (PCA). Quantile-on-quantile (QQ) regression captures non-linear dependencies across the joint distributions of sentiment and equity returns, incorporating macroeconomic control variables. Ordinary least squares regression provides a baseline comparison. Robustness is assessed using an alternative sentiment index constructed via partial least squares (PLS).
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    Investor sentiment exhibits a non-linear, asymmetric and state-dependent relationship with Chinese equity returns. Positive associations predominate during normal and optimistic market conditions, whereas negative relationships emerge when extreme pessimism coincides with severe market downturns. The magnitude and direction of these effects differ considerably across sectors, reflecting heterogeneous sensitivities to market conditions. Sentiment effects are particularly pronounced at extreme quantiles, indicating their economic relevance beyond conventional statistical significance. Results using the PLS-based sentiment index broadly corroborate the PCA-based findings, supporting the robustness of the principal sentiment–return patterns.
                  
                  
                    Originality
                    This study extends behavioural finance research by applying QQ regression to examine investor sentiment and equity returns simultaneously across market-wide and ten sectoral distributions in China. Unlike conventional approaches focusing on average effects, it identifies heterogeneous sentiment–return relationships across market regimes and industries. The research contributes evidence from a major emerging equity market characterised by distinctive institutional arrangements and substantial retail investor participation. By distinguishing conditional return predictability from priced systematic risk, it also offers a more theoretically precise interpretation of sentiment’s role in equity markets.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】**研究目的**  
本研究探讨了中国投资者情绪与股票回报之间的非线性及非对称关系，分析了在不同市场环境下情绪如何影响整体市场及各个行业的回报表现。研究旨在验证情绪-回报关系在牛市、熊市和中性市场环境中的变化情况，以及在不同特征的行业间的差异。通过关注中国独特的制度环境，本研究有助于将投资者情绪视为一种依赖于市场状态的股票回报预测因素，而不仅仅是一个被市场定价的系统风险因素。

**研究设计/方法**  
本研究使用2014年1月至2023年12月的月度数据，分析了沪深300指数和十个行业指数。投资者情绪指数是根据Baker和Wurgler（2006）的方法，通过主成分分析（PCA）构建的。分位数回归（QQ回归）用于捕捉情绪与股票回报联合分布中的非线性依赖关系，并纳入了宏观经济控制变量；普通最小二乘回归则作为基准对比方法。为了评估模型的稳健性，还使用偏最小二乘法（PLS）构建了另一种情绪指数。

**研究结果**  
投资者情绪与中国股票回报之间存在非线性、非对称且依赖于市场状态的关系：在正常和乐观的市场环境下，情绪与回报呈正相关；而在极端悲观情绪与严重市场下跌同时出现时，两者呈...。研究方法：回归分析、主成分分析。

papers.title: Bond yield dynamics: a multi-country multi-horizon string model
papers.abstract: This article extends the forward rate curve model of Baaquie and Bouchaud (2004) and Le Coz and Bouchaud (2024) to the multi-country setting of government bond markets. Cross-country blocks of correlation matrices of realized yield changes are found to display significant asymmetry between maturities. In the framework of the proposed model, this amounts to give to each country an idiosyncratic time scale. Each time scale describes how the perceived time between future dates depends on the dates themselves. The differences between these time scales structure the interactions between curves and reproduce the characteristic asymmetry of cross-country correlation matrices. The proposed model captures the full set of cross-curve correlations simultaneously at both daily and intra-day frequencies. When calibrated on government bonds issued by nine countries of the euro-zone, the typical reconstruction error is 1.7%.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文将Baaquie和Bouchaud（2004年）以及Le Coz和Bouchaud（2024年）提出的远期利率曲线模型扩展到了政府债券市场的多国环境。研究发现，各国实际收益率变化的相关矩阵在跨国家组中表现出显著的期限不对称性。在所提出的模型框架下，这意味着每个国家都拥有其独特的时间尺度；每个时间尺度描述了人们对未来日期之间间隔的感知如何随这些日期本身而变化。这些时间尺度之间的差异构成了不同利率曲线之间的相互作用机制，并再现了跨国相关矩阵所特有的不对称性。该模型能够同时捕捉到日度和日内频率下的所有利率曲线之间的相关性。当使用欧元区九个国家发行的政府债券数据进行校准时，模型的典型重建误差为1.7%。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Entry Deterrence with Public Signals: Revisiting the Chain-Store Paradox
papers.abstract: We revisit the classic chain-store paradox by introducing exogenous public signals about the incumbent's private type that arrive each period over a finite horizon. We fully characterize perfect Bayesian equilibria in terms of sequences of reputation cutoffs that increase over time: entrants enter below their cutoff, while the normal incumbent mixes below its cutoff and fights above it. The equilibrium outcome is generically unique. Information arrival dampens the incentive to build a reputation, so full deterrence need not emerge as the horizon grows arbitrarily long, even when the incumbent is very patient. We characterize exactly when there is full deterrence in the limit, along with the limiting equilibrium when there is not.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们重新审视了经典的连锁店悖论，引入了关于现有企业私人类型的外生公共信号，这些信号在有限的时间内每隔一段时间就会出现。我们通过描述随时间递增的声誉阈值序列，完整地刻画了完美贝叶斯均衡的机制：新进入者会在低于其声誉阈值的条件下进入市场，而原有的企业则会在低于其阈值的情况下开展竞争，在高于其阈值的情况下采取其他策略。这种均衡结果通常是唯一的。信息的传递会削弱企业建立声誉的动机，因此即使现有企业具有很强的耐心，当时间范围无限延长时，也不一定会出现完全的威慑效应。我们精确地确定了在何种极限情况下会出现完全的威慑效应，以及在没有威慑效应时的均衡状态。。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Statistical Inference with Ill-Conditioned Random Weight Neural Network Sieves
papers.abstract: Random weight neural networks (RWNNs) are shallow networks whose hidden-layer parameters are randomly generated and then kept fixed, while only the output coefficients are estimated. Conditional on the sampled parameters, RWNN regression is a linear sieve problem with random approximation space. We show that such random sieves cannot remain uniformly well-conditioned as their dimension grows. For parametrized feature families satisfying polynomial covering and Lipschitz conditions, the eigenvalues of the population covariance matrix are proven to have polynomial upper bounds determined by the covering geometry of the parameter space, leading to a vanishing smallest eigenvalue. We develop approximation, estimation, and inference theory that explicitly treats the ill-conditioning. Under a $β$-Hölder source condition, we obtain both faster-than-Monte-Carlo $L^2$ approximation rates and new $L^\infty$ approximation bounds based on stratified sampling. We then derive improved consistency guarantees for ridge-regularized least squares driven by ridge effective dimension, spectral, and leverage-based stability conditions. For inference, we establish asymptotic linearity and Gaussian limits for linear functional directions while allowing the smallest eigenvalue of the population covariance matrix to vanish. Nondegeneracy is directional: we characterize it with a ridge-normalized Rayleigh quotient and extend it to smooth functionals via Riesz representation. Consistency of ridge-adjusted variance estimators is proved, yielding feasible studentized inference. Numerical experiments illustrate the deterioration of random-feature conditioning and the finite-sample behavior of the resulting estimation and inference procedures.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随机权重神经网络（Random Weight Neural Networks，RWNNs）是一种浅层网络，其隐藏层参数是随机生成的并保持不变，仅估计输出系数。在给定采样参数的条件下，RWNN回归问题可视为具有随机逼近空间的线性筛选问题（linear sieve problem）。我们证明了随着网络维度的增加，这类随机筛选方法难以保持良好的数值稳定性（uniformly well-conditioned）。对于满足多项式覆盖（polynomial covering）和Lipschitz条件的参数化特征族，群体协方差矩阵的特征值具有由参数空间覆盖结构决定的多项式上界，从而导致最小特征值趋于零。我们提出了相应的逼近、估计和推断理论，明确考虑了这种数值不稳定性的影响。在满足β-Hölder源条件（β-Hölder source condition）的情况下，我们基于分层采样（stratified sampling）获得了比蒙特卡洛方法更快的L^2逼近速率以及新的L^∞逼近界限。此外，我们还基于岭回归的有效维度（ridge effective dimension）、谱性质（spectral...。研究方法：回归分析、神经网络、实验方法。

papers.title: Interpreting the Morbidity Gap
papers.abstract: The Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study now reports the morbidity gap (MG), life expectancy minus healthy life expectancy, as an indicator in its own right. Writing MG as the expected cumulative rate of years lived with disability (YLDs) at the life-table age at death, we use stochastic dominance results to show what MG measures, how it responds to mortality and how it relates to the YLDs of the current population. We show the following. (a) A YLD profile gives an MG no larger than another's under every life table if and only if its cumulative YLD rate is nowhere higher. (b) With YLD rates fixed, lower mortality at every age widens MG, so that removing a risk factor that raises mortality reduces MG by less than its contribution to MG in GBD's risk factor attribution. (c) A family of results gives easily interpretable conditions on the age structure of the population for the crude YLD rate to be above or below the life-table YLD rate, which is MG divided by life expectancy, and these conditions change with population ageing. We illustrate the results for Singapore, where MG widened from 8.9 to 11.2 years between 1990 and 2023.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】《全球疾病负担》（Global Burden of Disease, GBD）研究现已将“发病率差距”（Morbidity Gap, MG）——即预期寿命与健康预期寿命之间的差值——作为一项独立的指标进行评估。我们将发病率差距定义为在死亡年龄对应的生命表中，预期残疾年数（Years of Lost Disability, YLDs）的累积率。通过运用随机优势理论（stochastic dominance analysis），我们阐明了发病率差距的实质、它对死亡率变化的响应机制，以及其与当前人群残疾年数（YLDs）之间的关联。研究得出以下结论：  
(a) 只有当某生命表的累计残疾年数率在任何年龄点都不高于另一生命表时，其对应的发病率差距才不会大于后者。  
(b) 在残疾年数率固定的情况下，各年龄段的死亡率降低会扩大发病率差距；因此，消除某一导致死亡率上升的风险因素所减少的发病率差距，其程度小于该风险因素对全球疾病负担评估中发病率差距的总体贡献。  
(c) 有一组易于理解的条件，可用于判断人口的年龄结构如何影响粗残疾年率（crude YLD rate）是高于还是低于生命表中的残...。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Structural economic change under the digital transformation
papers.abstract: Productivity improvements in digital industries could massively reshape the structure of production networks and drive significant labour reallocation across sectors. We examine these adjustments using a calibrated agent-based model of the global economy. We consider two scenarios with the same cumulative increase in digital-supplier productivity, which differ in how digital inputs in exposed industries are incorporated into production. The key difference is whether digital inputs enter as standard intermediate inputs (low embeddedness) or are combined directly with primary factors (high embeddedness). Across economies, both scenarios generate gains in gross output, household utility, and GDP, although value-added gains are more modest and unevenly distributed across sectors. High embeddedness generally amplifies production responses, particularly in industries highly exposed to digital inputs. Structurally, as digital industries become central in the production network and attract labour from other activities, other industries move further upstream and downstream. Persistent labour reallocation pressures also indicate potential unemployment risks where workers cannot move to expanding industries. These findings stress that, beyond productivity gains derived from advances in digital technologies, economic and social consequences depend on how digital inputs integrate into production and on workers' possibilities to adapt to structural change.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】数字产业生产率的提升可能会极大地重塑生产网络的结构，并推动各行业之间的劳动力重新分配。我们利用一个经过校准的基于代理的全球经济模型来研究这些变化。我们考虑了两种情景：这两种情景下数字供应商的生产率都有相同的累积提升，但数字投入在相关行业中的整合方式有所不同。关键的区别在于，数字投入是作为标准中间投入被纳入生产过程（低嵌入性），还是直接与初级生产要素结合使用（高嵌入性）。在所有经济体中，这两种情景都能带来总产出、家庭福利和GDP的增长，不过附加值提升较为有限，且在各行业之间的分布并不均衡。高嵌入性通常会放大生产效应，尤其是在那些高度依赖数字投入的行业。从结构上看，随着数字产业在生产网络中占据核心地位并吸引其他行业的劳动力，其他行业会向产业链的上下游方向进一步延伸。持续的劳动力重新分配压力也意味着存在潜在的失业风险，尤其是在工人无法转移到增长较快行业的情况下。这些发现表明，除了数字技术进步所带来的生产力提升外，经济和社会后果还取决于数字投入如何融入生产过程，以及工人适应结构变化的能力。。研究方法：模型校准。
